text:
Avery M: FYI customer sent a SOC2/ISO questionnaire that calls out log retention, redaction, access approvals, subprocessors, and encryption. Need quick, copy-paste answers by EOD PST. questionnaire: https://redwood.share/q123 (attached). Who can own?

Sophie G: I can handle the logging/redaction bits. Which environments do they want details for?

Avery M: Prod and Dedicated. They specifically ask: do logs contain PII, how do we redact, who can view raw logs, retention windows, and encryption in transit/at rest. Also a subprocessors list.

Sophie G: Short answers: we redact user identifiers (email, phone, SSN) from app logs via a server-side redaction layer. Access is restricted to SRE + oncall with approved ticket. Retention: 30 days by default for debug logs, 1 year for aggregated metrics. Will draft exact wording.

Devon L: For access approvals, we need an approval workflow: request in IAM -> ticket -> approval by SRE lead + security. Usually the ticket template is in #eng-oncall. I can create INF ticket and link.

Priya K: subprocessors: cloud infra (CloudProviderX), datadog/metrics (MetricsCo), auth provider (OktaCorp). Legal owns exact contract language, but we can list names. I'll confirm and paste final list.

Jamal R: Encryption note: disks and EBS volumes are encrypted AES-256; DBs use KMS CMKs. Hosted (Redwood API) uses Redwood-managed KMS by default; Private deployments can be configured to use customer-managed KMS (we should call that out).

Sophie G: Quick config snippet for redaction we can paste:```json
{
  "log_redaction": {
    "patterns": ["\"email\":\s*\"[^\"]+\"","\"phone\":\s*\"[^\"]+\""] ,
    "replacement": "[REDACTED]"
  }
}
```This is our runtime redaction layer in prod. It runs before logs hit s3/archival.

sec-bot: Audit logs note: All access to log storage and K/V caches is recorded in the audit trail (CloudProviderX CloudTrail + internal access events). Link: https://redwood.share/audit-logs 

Devon L: Filing INF-4321 to track access approval wording + export of current log samples (sanitized). Will link doc + add reviewers: @Priya K, @Jamal R, @Sophie G.

Sophie G: Draft answers (feel free to copy):
Q: Do logs contain PII? A: No customer PII is intentionally logged. Identifiers that may be PII are redacted at ingest via a server-side redaction layer; see snippet.
Q: Who can access raw logs? A: Access is limited to SRE and Security with an approved access request and ticket. All accesses are audited.
Q: Retention windows? A: Debug logs: 30 days default; structured traces/metrics: 365 days. Retention configurable per-customer for Dedicated/Private.
Q: Encryption? A: In transit via TLS 1.2+, at rest using AES-256 with KMS-managed keys. Private deployments support customer-managed KMS.
Q: Subprocessors? A: CloudProviderX (infra), MetricsCo (telemetry), OktaCorp (auth). Legal confirms contract status.

Avery M: This is great — can you paste those into the questionnaire? Need final by 18:00 PST. Assigning to Sophie. (Thanks emoji)

Priya K: I'll double-check subprocessors and add legal's note.

Jamal R: +1 on encryption wording.

Sophie G: Will paste into questionnaire and ping when done. Posting final draft here when completed.

Avery M: Thanks team. Devon — please link INF-4321 in the final submission.
